description: Flat record-level metadata schema for iPSC lines derived from multiple donors and assessed for genomic stability under varying culture conditions using SNP arrays and whole-genome sequencing across passages.

record_id.descr: Unique identifier for this metadata record (one iPSC line under one culture condition and one assay/timepoint context). Example: 'IPSC001_P12_WGS'.

ipi_line_id.descr: Persistent identifier for the iPSC line or clone. Use a stable lab accession or UUID.

clone_id.descr: Clone/subline identifier if multiple clones were derived from the same donor. Example: 'CloneA'.

donor_id.descr: De-identified donor identifier linking back to donor-level records.

donor_age_years.descr: Donor age at sample collection, in years.

donor_sex.descr: Donor biological sex or sex assigned at birth. Recommended controlled values: 'female', 'male', 'intersex', 'unknown'.

donor_ancestry_or_ethnicity.descr: Self-reported ancestry/ethnicity or harmonized group, if available. Use controlled vocabulary where possible.

original_cell_type.descr: Primary somatic cell type used to generate the iPSC line, e.g. 'fibroblast', 'PBMC', 'keratinocyte'.

original_cell_source_tissue.descr: Source tissue of the starting somatic cells, if distinct from cell type. Example: 'skin', 'blood'.

reprogramming_method.descr: Method used to generate iPSCs, e.g. 'Sendai virus', 'episomal', 'integrating lentiviral', 'mRNA'.

culture_medium_base.descr: Base culture medium used for this record, e.g. 'mTeSR1', 'E8', 'KSR-based'.

culture_supplements.descr: Key additives/supplements in the culture medium, separated by semicolons if multiple. Examples: 'FGF2; TGF-beta; insulin'.

media_batch_id.descr: Identifier for the medium or supplement batch/lot, if tracked.

oxygen_concentration_percent.descr: Incubation oxygen concentration during culture, expressed as percent O2 (e.g. 5.0, 20.9).

carbon_dioxide_concentration_percent.descr: Incubation CO2 concentration during culture, expressed as percent CO2.

temperature_celsius.descr: Culture temperature in degrees Celsius, typically 37.0.

substrate_or_matrix.descr: Culture substrate or extracellular matrix coating, e.g. 'Matrigel', 'vitronectin', 'feeder layer'.

passaging_method.descr: Passaging technique used, e.g. 'enzyme-free dissociation', 'EDTA', 'collagenase', 'manual picking'.

passage_number.descr: Passage number at the time of genomic/phenotypic assessment.

split_ratio.descr: Split ratio used at the last passage, if applicable, expressed as a numeric ratio or fold split encoded as text when not directly numeric.

culture_duration_days.descr: Number of days in the specified culture condition before sampling or assay.

cell_density_at_passage.descr: Approximate cell density at passaging or seeding, expressed as cells per cm^2 or cells per well depending on assay context. State the unit convention consistently in accompanying documentation.

confluency_percent.descr: Estimated confluency at the time of passage or sampling, as a percentage.

supplement_change_flag.descr: Whether the culture supplement regimen differed from the standard/control condition for this record.

oxygen_condition_flag.descr: Whether the oxygen condition differed from ambient normoxia/control culture for this record.

passaging_condition_flag.descr: Whether the passaging technique differed from the standard/control condition for this record.

snp_array_performed.descr: Indicates whether SNP array profiling was performed for this record.

snp_array_platform.descr: SNP array platform/manufacturer, e.g. 'Illumina OmniExpress', 'CytoScan HD'.

snp_array_assay_date.descr: Date the SNP array assay was performed.

wgs_performed.descr: Indicates whether whole-genome sequencing was performed for this record.

wgs_library_type.descr: Library preparation type for WGS, e.g. 'PCR-free', 'paired-end', 'mate-pair'.

wgs_read_length_bp.descr: Read length in base pairs for WGS reads (e.g. 150).

wgs_coverage_depth_x.descr: Mean sequencing depth/coverage for WGS, in X-fold coverage.

wgs_assay_date.descr: Date the WGS assay was performed.

genomic_aberration_detected.descr: Whether any genomic aberration was detected in this record by any assay.

aberration_type.descr: Primary class of genomic aberration detected. Recommended values: 'SNV', 'indel', 'CNV', 'aneuploidy', 'LOH', 'SV', 'other', 'none'.

aberration_chromosome.descr: Chromosome affected by the aberration, if applicable. Use 'X', 'Y', autosome number, or 'NA' if not applicable.

aberration_start_bp.descr: Genomic start coordinate of the aberration, in base pairs, if known.

aberration_end_bp.descr: Genomic end coordinate of the aberration, in base pairs, if known.

aberration_gene.descr: Gene(s) overlapping the aberration or most likely impacted, if annotated. Separate multiple genes with semicolons.

aberration_description.descr: Free-text description of the detected genomic change, including size, classification, and interpretation.

aberration_burden_count.descr: Number of aberrations detected in this record, if quantifiable.

aberration_burden_fraction.descr: Fraction of genome affected by aberrations, if applicable, expressed as 0-1 proportion.

aberration_validation_status.descr: Validation state of the aberration call, e.g. 'confirmed', 'putative', 'not_validated'.

phenotypic_change_observed.descr: Whether any phenotypic change was observed in association with culture conditions or genomic instability.

phenotype_description.descr: Free-text description of observed phenotypic changes, e.g. altered morphology, growth rate, differentiation capacity.

growth_rate_change_percent.descr: Change in growth rate relative to matched control, expressed as percent change.

morphology_change_flag.descr: Whether morphology changed relative to control or baseline.

differentiation_capacity_change_flag.descr: Whether differentiation capacity changed relative to control or baseline.

apoptosis_or_viability_change_flag.descr: Whether apoptosis, viability, or survival changed relative to control or baseline.

qc_status.descr: Overall quality-control status for this record, e.g. 'pass', 'warn', 'fail'.

qc_notes.descr: Any QC-related notes affecting interpretation of the record.

operator_id.descr: Identifier for the experimenter or pipeline responsible for generating the record, if tracked.

protocol_version.descr: Version identifier for the culture and assay protocol used.
